preconditions: Trusted admitted control connection and runtime-bound current-session proof; existing local credential/password and current Fresh verified MFA/access
Serving owner retains physical/lifetime, unusable-handle retirement and exclusive legacy routing before real enablement
postconditions: Both KDFs outside writer; current credential/session/access rechecked under final writer
Credential, own reset invalidation, optional all-own rotation, lifecycle triggers and audit commit together
Prepared bounded user JSON and cookie released only after known commit; no bearer JSON, no replay after unknown
Source positive user receipt and native true own-user receipt accepted; malformed/error/transport never claims UI success
external_effects: Bounded shared process admission and post-known-commit HTTP user/cookie response
Explicit account UI confirmation/refresh or cleared-input uncertainty guidance only
